name: writfold
description: Git-native project continuity: a KB brief at session start, local checkpoint drafts at compaction and stop, a skill teaching the writfold kb verbs, and a writfold:evaluate skill that closes a run with a reflection. Needs the writfold binary on PATH.

kb_root.title: KB root
kb_root.description: The project KB (the directory holding inventory/assets/). Leave empty to use $WRITFOLD_KB, the nearest KB above the session's directory, or the prototype configuration's root.
